avis.titre: I take this everywhere I go
avis.texte: I really love this sunscreen stick. It glides on smooth and clear with a satin finish, so there's no white cast, and it works great under makeup or on bare skin. The packaging is cute and kind of retro and it reminds me of an old 50s vacation ad or a beach malt shop which makes it fun to pull out and use. The size fits perfectly in my purse or pocket, so I can reapply throughout the day when I'm out. It has a really nice, subtle scent that feels fresh without being too strong, and the formula is lightweight, not greasy. The stick format (a flat, small tube) is absolutely perfect for throwing in a bag, traveling, or doing on‑the‑go touch‑ups. I would definitely recommend it and would repurchase.

Definitely changing my all time sunscreen for this one and I don't think I will try any other in a near future.

avis.titre: Good for everyday, not water resistant though
avis.texte: Vacation Super Stick Face Sunscreen is seriously one of my favorite finds for everyday SPF, especially if you wear makeup. The stick makes it so easy to swipe on—no mess, no sticky hands, and it goes on super smooth without pulling on your skin. It blends in really nicely with no white cast and doesn't mess up foundation or concealer at all. I love that it feels lightweight and not greasy, because nobody wants that heavy sunscreen feeling on their face. It almost feels like a little primer under makeup. And can we talk about the smell? It actually smells good and not like typical sunscreen. That said, from what I've found, it doesn't seem to be water resistant, which is kind of disappointing if you're sweating or outside a lot. So for beach or workout days, I'd probably reach for something else. But for everyday wear and reapplying over makeup, it's super convenient and really comfortable to use. 💛 *received as part of educational promotion*

This sun stick is honestly such a great product- it goes on so easily and never tugs at my skin, and the shape of it makes it so that I can use different ends for different parts of my face which is really nice. I'm also happy that it's transparent, so I can apply it and don't have any white cast on my skin. Note, that it has chemical sunscreens.
